correctness.rationale: In a right equilateral prism with half-height/circumradius H>0, generic central-plane polygon sides are counted by the sign changes across six base and three vertical edges. The three projected corner dot products sum to zero, so ordering their absolute values reduces all cases to 3,4,5 sides; conditional |U_z| is uniform and gives P(t<b)=b/sqrt(H^2+b^2). Integrating over a sextant yields p3=1-(6/pi)asin(1/(2sqrt(1+H^2))), p5=(6/pi)[2asin(sqrt3/(2sqrt(1+H^2)))-asin(1/(2sqrt(1+H^2)))-asin(1/sqrt(1+H^2))], p4 complementary. Direct derivative of J(H)=sqrt3 H/sqrt(H^2+1/4)-H/(2sqrt(H^2+3/4)) is positive for H>0, with J(0)=0 and J(infty)>1; unique pentagon optimum H*=0.531469551... and p5≈0.3851558057. p3 is strictly increasing and invertible. The included direct-edge Monte Carlo is supporting evidence only; analytic cases/integrals prove continuum. Independently compared exact formula against older arccos law at H=.2,.531469551,.9,2 with differences under 1e-12.
